output.summary: A biennial herb found through most of Europe and into the Maghreb and western Asia. Hairy, purple-spotted stems and swollen nodes help distinguish it; eating the poisonous plant can cause digestive inflammation, drowsiness, vertigo and cardiac weakness.
output.edibilityNote: Eating the plant can cause digestive inflammation, drowsiness, vertigo and cardiac weakness; toxins occur mainly in its upper parts and fruits.
